greeting.text: A messenger from the king? We have done nothing. Please, there must be some mistake.

beware.text: The fog has watched this square for years, and the moment that package opened it woke. It will not stop at me. Kill it! And if you live, find Ryn, the shrine-keeper; she knew what that fog was before any of us did.

grateful.text: It is dead. I never thought I would see this square without the fog watching us. Speak with Ryn, the shrine-keeper: she warned us, and she has been asking for whoever dealt with the thing.
